Based on the onboarding guide, this happens because **`provider: auto` prioritizes remote API keys found in environment variables** over local endpoints. When you added your OpenRouter API key to your `.env`, Hermes automatically prioritized the remote provider.

To force Hermes to use your local setup instead of remote endpoints:
* Set **`provider: custom`** in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`.

*(Note: The document does not contain details about specific hardcoded fallback models for auxiliary tasks like title generation, but setting `provider: custom` enforces routing to your local configuration).*
